caption: The drawing depicts a single Western saddle rendered in brown tones, with intricate floral tooling on the leather. The saddle is viewed from the side, clearly showing the curved seat, high cantle, and horn at the front. The stirrup and stirrup leather are visible on the left, hanging downward with a rounded stirrup cover or fender. The saddle blanket underneath is a muted brownish-red, contrasting with the medium tan and darker brown hues of the tooled saddle leather. Some hardware, such as circular conchos and metal rings, is present, and a cinch strap hangs on the right side. The background is an off-white, unadorned space. The artist's signature, "Arthur E. Reynolds," appears below the saddle on the right.
title: Saddle
